name: error-state
title: Error state
description: Full-section error or not found screen with a code or icon, explanation and retry actions.
htmlExample:
<bef-error-state class="w-full max-w-md" code="404" title="Page not found" description="The page you are after moved or never existed.">
  <bef-button variant="outline">Go home</bef-button>
</bef-error-state>
